scope: Primary RGO diagram registration to current CAD; evidence and working envelope, not an approved detailed exhibit arrangement.

pixelToWorldXZ.formula: x = xFromV[0]*pixelV + xFromV[1]; z = zFromU[0]*pixelU + zFromU[1]
pixelToWorldXZ.method: Axis-aligned least-squares registration using 11 visually identified column-grid intersections. Current CAD column centres independently extracted at body height8.2m; no exhibit coordinates used.
pixelToWorldXZ.limitation: Small residual is fit of the selected structural grid, not full architectural equivalence. Stair/lift islands and some enclosure walls differ between the source diagram and current CAD.

limitations: The orange overlay interrupts the visible red area. Visible-red contours alone are not the complete route.
The source provides nine named callout points, not nine dimensioned closed room polygons. Exact inter-room boundaries are not invented.
Floor support checks use actual horizontal main-floor CAD triangles. BaseGrid checks separately include body clearance and fixed architecture.
Visitor anchors are suggestions in the original programme area. They do not validate full wall, display, ceiling or furniture geometry.
Structural column registration agrees to raster-pick tolerance, but several stair/lift positions differ visibly between revisions. Keep all actual CAD structures intact and fit exhibits around them.
The previously proposed RGO14x22m position near world(-4,32) does not follow this source and must not be treated as primary.
